## [1.8.3 (October 25th, 2026)](#1-8-3)

### Additions
- Added compatability with AppleSkin.

### New Rideable Pokémon
- Vikavolt
- Fearow

### Particles
#### New Move Animations
- Water Shuriken

### Cries added/updated for the following Pokémon
- Hoppip
- Skiploom
- Jumpluff
- Houndour

- Flapple (updated)

### Animation updates for the following Pokémon
- Vikavolt
- Magby

- Ninetales (+ Alolan)
- Spearow

- Squawkabilly
- Mudkip
- Marshtomp
- Swampert

### Changes
- Changed the Misc icon in the Campfire Pot Recipe Book to Health Candy.
- Moved EXP Candies from the Medicine recipe book category to the Misc category.
- Removed Dynamic Lights data from the Magmarizer item for consistency with the block.
- Added `doPokemonPredation` game rule, which controls aggressiveness of Pokémon with the `hate_entity` brain task defined.
- Added `predation_chance` server config value, which controls the possibility of attacking the hated entity found in `hate_entity` brain tasks.
- Prehistoric Eroded Pillar generates slightly more frequently.
- Togekiss was changed from a jet-style mount to bird-style.

### Fixes
- Fixed datapacks with item interaction evolutions that don't specify an item crashing the world on load.
- Fixed the Pokédex evolution tree crashing when a datapack's dex entry is missing an evolution's form.
- Fixed the Pokédex evolution tree crashing with a stack overflow on evolutions that loop back on themselves.
- Fixed the Pokédex evolution tree crashing when looking at a dex that is not part of the "National Dex" aggregate.
- Fixed some display names in the Pokédex evolution tree having unintended font colours.
- Fixed evolution trees not building properly when a Pokémon has several Pokédex entries for different regions.
- Fixed form-changing evolutions sometimes resolving to the source form in the Pokédex evolution tree.
- Broken datapack evolutions are now logged and skipped in the Pokédex evolution tree instead of crashing.
- Fixed the `alpha` property having no tab completion in commands such as `/pokespawn`, `/pokegive` and `/pokeedit`, and added the missing `dmax_level`, `gmax_factor` and `tradable` aliases to tab completion.
- Fixed friendship booster items not being recognised as such.
- Fixed conflicts with other mods that would make use of recipe books in certain ways (Farmer's Delight Cooking Pot).
- Fixed Pokémon battles stalling when a sidemod cancels the `THROWN_POKEBALL_HIT` hit event.
- Fixed choice feature tab completion in `spawnpokemon/pokegive/pokeedit` commands.
- Fixed MoLang that's targeting players intermittedly failing when they have died, requiring them to relog.
- Fixed a NeoForge bug where none of the Cobblemon plants/berries could be placed into pots.
- Fixed party overlay not hiding when the player opens the Pokédex scanner.
- Fixed `hate_entity` task focusing on its own entity, therefore enabling deadly warfare between Zangoose and Seviper.
- Prehistoric Frozen Pond, Prehistoric Frozen Spike, and Prehistoric Lush Den now actually generate (oops).
- Fixed Frogadier floating in its `battle_idle` animation.
- Fixed absence or incorrect mergers in spawning conditions, causing the max height/depth of conditions to use the min value instead.
- Added stricter riding checks on server side to prevent possible packet forgery when a player tries to ride Pokémon.
- Fixed Pokémon cries and animation sounds played from GUIs, such as the starter selection screen and the Pokédex, being tied to the Master volume slider instead of Friendly Creatures.
- Fixed Archeops T-posing during its `air_cry` animation.

### Developer
- Bumped NeoForge to `21.1.195` to get access to MixinExtras `0.5` and the expressions annotation.
- New Platform Event `PLAYER_RESPAWN` which is fired when a player respawns (either through death or returning from the end).
- Platform Events `SERVER_PLAYER_TICK_PRE` and `SERVER_PLAYER_TICK_POST` no longer fire when the player is dead.
  - It is now tied much closer to the actual entity rather than the player or their connection.

### Molang & Datapacks
- Fixed `q.pokemon.nature` returning class instance instead of proper string value (`cobblemon:adamant`).
- Fixed `q.entity.is_looking_at` result being always `1` for whatever entity passed as the target parameter.
- Added hate chance optional parameter to `hate_entity` task. `1.0` will make an entity always attack the target.

### Localization
- Updated translations for:
  - Russian
  - Japanese
  - Brazilian Portuguese

## [1.8.2 (October 11th, 2026)](#1-8-2)

### Additions
- The following items can now be placed on the ground as blocks:
  - King's Rock, Galarica Cuff, Unremarkable Teacup, Masterpiece Teacup, Chipped Pot, Cracked Pot, Sachet, Metal Powder, Quick Powder, Bright Powder, Soft Sand, Electirizer, Magmarizer, Icy Rock, Heat Rock, Smooth Rock, Damp Rock, Destiny Knot, Luminous Moss, Never-Melt Ice, Wide Lens, Scope Lens, and Zoom Lens.
  - I wasn't finished. Iron Ball, Metal Coat, Throat Spray, Terrain Extender, Medicinal Brew, Moomoo Milk, HP Up, Protein, Iron, Carbos, Calcium, Zinc, PP Up, PP Max, Upgrade, Dubious Disc, and Loaded Dice.
- The following items can now be placed on various surfaces:
  - Galarica Wreath, Magnet, Flame Orb, Life Orb, Toxic Orb, Light Ball, and Smoke Ball.
- The following items can now be placed as blocks and have additional functionality:
  - Ring Target, Metronome, and Eject Button.
- The following items can now be worn by Players and Pokémon:
  - Galarica Wreath, Cleanse Tag, Spell Tag, Sharp Beak, Covert Cloak, Shell Helmet, and Never-Melt Ice.
- Wearable items can now be equipped by a player by holding it and right-clicking (or whatever you've rebound use/interact to).
  - Wearable items that can be placed down are exempt from this behaviour.
- Mint Leaves can now be placed on the ground as Leaf Litter, or in Flower Pots.
- The recall animation now renders the ball in hand with the player's arm raised.
- Added Oricorio Flowers.
- Added Terrain Plants, four plants grown from Electric, Grassy, Misty, and Psychic Seeds, which glow under specific environmental conditions and can be farmed for more of their seeds.
- Berries can now be placed in Flower Pots.
- The evolution tree for a Pokémon can now be viewed in the Pokédex, showing the Pokémon's full family line and what's needed to evolve into each stage.
- Added custom sounds to a bunch of items that can be placed as blocks: liquid bottles, pill bottles, powders, and dice.
- Added paper as a new cosmetic item for Pikachu.
- Burmy changes its cloak after a battle it took part in, based on the biome.
  - Trash Cloak in the Deep Dark, Nether and End.
  - Plant Cloak in lush biomes such as forests, jungles, plains and swamps.
  - Sandy Cloak in sandy biomes, beaches and caves.

### Changes
- Slowed the speed of Type Gem growth, and revamped their generation to grow in a more crystal-like shape.
- Terrain Seeds can now be planted.
- Terrain Seeds are now consumed during PvP and NPC battles.
- Glow Item Frames can be crafted using Bright Powder as an alternative to Glow Ink Sacs.
- Bright Powder can be used on Signs and Hanging Signs to make text glow, as an alternative to Glow Ink Sacs.
- Updated various recipes to display in Recipe Groups within the Recipe Book.
- Updated most recipes to display more logically and consistently within the Recipe Book's categories.
- Updated the following recipes
  - Never-Melt Ice, Focus Sash, Blunder Policy, Weakness Policy, Blank TM.
- Made ride rotations less jittery in multiplayer.
- Changes Disc Shelf TMs to use textures instead of tinting and overlays to line up with item display.
- Blank TM can now be inserted into the Disc Shelf.
- Added a TM creative tab.
- Made regional and Vivillon split-evo locations mutually exclusive.
- Vivillon's patterns are now viewable as forms with form names and unique Pokédex entries displayed.
- Item evolutions now unlock **all** locked evolutions whose requirements are met instead of stopping after the first.
  - Exceptions being "forced" evolutions which stop after the first one.
- Removed Mega Drain as a TM.
- PokeSnacks (and other area spawns) will now start the vertical offset checking from the center rather than base coordinate
  - This will help PokeSnacks to work inside caves or tighter spaces better.

### Fixes
- Type Gem blocks now properly generate clusters off of the block.
- Correctly grant "They're Minerals!" advancement when planting a Type Gem.
- Shoulder mounted Pokémon now follow player body animations, improving their positioning with custom player animations and default actions.
- Shoulder mounted Pokémon now sit slightly higher with chest armor equipped for better alignment, with a configurable blacklist.
- Type Gem Blocks now have advancements to give you the recipe in the recipe book (the data for the advancements were inside the recipes somehow??).
  - Some other recipes without advancements have also been corrected.
- Corrected the TM Recipes for Charge Beam and Payday.
- Starter Screen Categories will no longer stop rendering if they are bigger than the viewport and you are not viewing the top or bottom edges.
- The Random Starter option no longer runs off into other categories or becomes unaccessible due to scroll limits if it causes a new row.
- Mochi and Feathers no longer drop glass bottles on use.
- Fixed a rare set of concurrency bugs related to reloading packs on NeoForge; fixes a ModernFix compatibility issue.
- Removed unnecessary conditions for Mimikyu's standing pose. Hopefully fixes the rare instance of it using its shoulder animations during battle in multiplayer scenarios.
- Fixed Rockruff line not blinking.
- Fixed Flygon sometimes using its running animation instead of walking.
- Fixed Bramblin always sleeping outside of battle.
- Fixed Dragonair using its battle idle as a normal idle.
- Fixed Lycanroc's head movement.
- Added head movement to Archaludon.
- Fixed Duraludon line not having any sleep animations.
- Fixed Diglett line not having their faint animations.
- Fixed Kingambit moving its legs while walking.
- Fixed Alolan Diglett's cry not playing.
- Fixed shiny alpha Snorlax using the non-shiny texture.
- Fixed Crabominable's head breaking when looking around.
- Fixed Shiny Dipplin and Hydrapple's textures.
- Various structure fixes.
- Fixed shiny Pokémon under certain circumstances forgetting taught TMs.
- Fixed certain Pokémon sounds sometimes being doubled when played at specific times in their animations.
- Fixed ball capture beam origin coming from behind the ball.
- Fixed Safari Ball catch rate outside of battle.
- Fixed alpha eye (and other) particles not respecting the client particle density setting in video options.
- Fixed the TM Machine UI not closing when player is moving away from it.
- Moved the config category for alpha/shiny chance config fields for fossil machine and honey log slathering to Spawning.
- Fixed crashes for addon species with non-Cobblemon namespaces in evolution, fishing bait, and Pokédex lookups.
- Bees will now grow Apricorns and the Galarica Nut Bush, which were in the bee growables tag but never handled, and correctly spend their nectar when they do.
- Saccharine Leaves can now be bone mealed.
- Fixed equipping a stack of wearable items instead of one item of a stack.
- Fixed TM stack consumption in TM Machine screen when a player teaches a move to a Pokémon.
- Fixed every Miltank giving mushroom stew, not only mushroom variants.
- Medicinal Leeks can now be eaten when they aren't being planted, matching their food properties.
- Sweeping attacks no longer set owned Pokémon on fire (e.g. with Fire Aspect) or knock them back. Friendly Fire is now off.
- Fixed Pokémon not losing their previous form's signature moves when changing forms (e.g. Rotom keeping Overheat after leaving its Heat form).
- Form-specific moves gained from a form change are now only granted if the Pokémon is high enough level to learn them, and no longer create duplicates in benched moves.
- Spinda now learns Teeter Dance at level 32 instead of via TM.
- Fixed Oricorio Pa'u form description in the Pokédex.
- Fixed PC playing sound on close when opened via command.

### Developer
- Evolution requirements can now set `pokedexIcon` and `pokedexTooltip` directly in their JSON to control how they're shown on the Pokédex's evolution tree, for example:
  ```json
  {
    "variant": "attack_defence_ratio",
    "pokedexIcon": "minecraft:diamond_sword",
    "pokedexTooltip": "cobblemon.ui.pokedex.requirement.attack_defence_ratio.tooltip"
  }
  ```
- Fixed the wrong order of operations in the code flow prior to the `FOSSIL_REVIVED` event causing Pokémon to appear without the entity link.
- Fixed TestPartySlot command not correctly comparing the provided spec with the target Pokémon.

### Molang & Datapacks
- A new `negate` variant for evolution requirements has been added, which will negate (invert) the provided inner condition.
- Added Molang functions for individual Pokédex ids, wherein a subdex is passed in as a string to `dex_caught_count` etc.
- Added a `battle_ended` callback, backed by the new `BATTLE_ENDED` event, which fires whenever a battle ends for any reason, alongside a multitude of flags not previously covered by `BATTLE_VICTORY`.
- Added `battle_pokemon` to battle actor structs and `has_faced_opponents` to battle Pokémon structs.
- Added the `cobblemon:form_change/bagworm_cloak/plant_cloak`, `sandy_cloak` and `trash_cloak` biome tags, which control Burmy's cloak after battle.

### Localization
- Updated translations for:
  - Brazilian Portuguese
  - Canadian French
  - Japanese
  - Korean
  - Russian
  - Ukrainian

## [1.8.1 (September 13th, 2026)](#1-8-1)

### Animation updates for the following Pokémon
- Flapple, Appletun, Dipplin, Hydrapple (placeholder animations only).

### Fixes
- Fixed a potential world generation stall caused by Type Gem clusters.
- Fixed Pokémon on shoulders not animating if they are visibly holding a held item.
- Fixed NPCs getting their own TM progress file.
- Fixed odd NeoForge crash due to a dependency being outdated. It will now correctly flag the dependency for being outdated.
- Fixed the TM Machine refusing move selections that the `unlockAllMoveDexMovesByDefault` config had made visible, leaving the move slot blank and the craft button unresponsive.
- Fixed the Beast Ball not applying its 0.1× penalty to Pokémon that are not Ultra Beasts.
- Fixed the Moon Ball reading the world's total elapsed time instead of the time of day, so its bonus applied during the day instead.
- Fixed the Love Ball never awarding its 2.5× opposite gender bonus, and matching species by display name instead of identifier.
- Fixed the Timer Ball being weaker than a regular Poké Ball on early turns and only reaching 4× on turn 14 instead of turn 10.
- Fixed the Luxury Ball only doubling Friendship gains of 1, leaving level up and berry gains unaffected.
- Fixed Rufflet, Braviary, and Hisuian Braviary flooding logs with errors about missing sound events.
- Fixed Pokémon property typos in Pangoro and Dedenne herd spawn files.
- Fixed unintentional watermelon cosmetic for Hisuian Electrode. 
- Fixed Blastoise having an unintentional passenger seat.
- Fixed form typo in Rockruff-Dusk spawn, preventing it from being able to spawn.
- Fixed the `stat_compare` and `stat_equal` evolution requirements crashing the game when given `special_attack` or `special_defence`, and made them treat any non-permanent stat as a failed requirement instead of crashing.
- Fixed Rowap and Jacoba berries not correctly altering Pokémon sizes when used as bait.
- Fixed Ampharos' eyes not emitting particles.
- Fixed Alolan Raticate's cry not playing.
- Fixed several incorrect light-based spawning conditions for ghosts and bugs. 
- Removed unused, placeholder habitat pools.
- Fixed Mantyke, Mantine, and Quaxly getting stuck in a recoil 'expression' during battles due to having an expression assigned as a recoil animation. 
- Fixed Lucario's aura particles not emitting.
- Fixed Lycanroc's head movement.
- Added head movement to Archaludon.
- Fixed Duraludon line not having their sleep animations.
- Fixed Diglett line not having their faint animations.
- Fixed Kingambit moving its legs while walking.

### Localization
- Updated translations for:
  - Brazilian Portuguese
  - Simplified Chinese
  - Japanese

## [1.8.0 - Make Your Move Update (September 6th, 2026)](#1-8-0)
#### I think the red eyes mean they're friendly!

### Additions
- Added Alpha Pokémon
  - Alpha Pokémon are bigger, stronger, and more aggressive than regular Pokémon.
  - They are also scarier.
  - They always know a TM move and will adapt to be stronger than your party.
  - Alphas will always lead herds and spawn in herds.
- Added alpha Pokémon attraction bait effect to Hopo Berries.
- Added intrinsic scaling to all Pokémon (anywhere from 5% smaller to 5% bigger than normal). Some cases, such as shoulder mounting, will not scale so that the shoulder animations don't look silly.
- Added scaling to "baby" Pokémon (10% smaller at level 1 → normally sized at level 10).
- Added TMs.
  - Added TM Machine. TMs are made from elemental type gems, and their recipes are unlocked by having Pokémon that know the move.
  - Added config options for making TMs infinite-use and instant unlocking of all TM recipes.
  - Added Type Gem blocks as well as crystal clusters and deepslate core blocks that are used for growing elemental type gems.
- Added a new Starter Selection menu that looks way better.
- Added a "Move Dex" to the Pokédex to help identify what moves a Pokémon can learn and what Pokémon can get a move.
- Added the Habitat Block, a spawner block for servers and adventure maps that controls spawning in an area.
- Added 49 new habitat structures. In these habitats you will find rarer Pokémon and sometimes different Pokémon will appear on different days.
- Added a toast to notify players of how they can scroll through their party. Did you know you can hold R and scroll instead of using arrow keys? It's true!!!
- Added a way to obtain Porygon by inserting an Upgrade or Dubious Disc into a data monitor.
- Added Disk Rack for storing disks and being an audio sequencer for Noteblocks. What does that have to do with Pokémon? How about you mind your own business!
- Added missing crops to Botany Pots integration.
- Added conditional seats for riding. Seats can be gated by Molang such as "is_alpha".
- Added 10 new ruin structures.
- Added a new shipwreck cove structure called the Magma Shipwreck Cove.
- Added 7 new advancements.
- Pokémon cries now play when clicking Pokémon in the summary screen.
- Held item visibility can now be controlled by the `held_item_visible` command argument.
- Added config option to disable Pokémon spawning on a per-world basis.
- Added config options to award experience to fainted Pokémon for opponents they helped defeat (`awardExperienceToFaintedPokemon`) and to still award experience for defeated enemies even after battle loss/forfeit (`awardExperienceOnBattleLoss`).
- Added `/givetm` command.
- Added advancement triggers for learning TMs: `cobblemon:has_learn_specific_tm` (per-TM), `cobblemon:has_learn_all_tm` (all TMs learned), and `cobblemon:tms_learned` (count-based), backed by a new `totalTMLearnedCount` on player advancement data.
- Added `cobblemon:catch_alpha_pokemon` advancement trigger and `totalAlphaCaptureCount` stat for captured Alpha Pokémon.

### Changes
- Removed the penalty for block destruction speed when on a hover mount, making them better for digging.
- Golden Apples can now be crafted using the Applin Apples.
- Prismarine Crystals and Amethyst Shards can now be used to craft Pokedexes.
- Updated Pokédex Screens item tag to support tagged variants of Redstone and Glowstone Dust.
- Sharp Beak can now be crafted using bones and Flying Gems.
- Metal Alloy can now be crafted using iron and Thunder Stones.
- Ability Capsules can now be brewed from Medicinal Brew and Dragon Breath.
- Using an Ability Capsule will now return an Empty Bottle.
- Decreased the default pastured wander radius to 32 blocks.
- Added alternate versions of the basic PC Wallpapers based on the original design of Cobblemon's PC, before public release.
- Rooted Arch Ruins, Crumbling Arch Ruins, and all fossil structures have been improved so that they generate more naturally in terrain.
- Gimmighoul towers now generate at ground-level rather than sinking one block into the ground.
- All ruin structures that did not generate with a gimmighoul/gilded chest before will now generate with one.
- All ruin structures gilded chest loot tables have been updated to include a guaranteed TM not learned naturally by any Pokémon through their level-up moveset. Each ruin gets its own specific TM, so you can now go hunting ruins to complete your move dex!
- The Prehistoric Underwater Fissure and Prehistoric Submerged Impact fossil structures now use the biome tag `#cobblemon:is_temperate_ocean`.
- The lush shipwreck cove's phantom mob spawner has been replaced with breezes.
- Shipwreck coves now generate slightly more frequently.
- Added equipment loot tables for shipwreck cove enemies.
- Maps from abandoned fishing boats leading to shipwreck coves now will skip explored chunks, allowing the player to find more shipwreck coves more easily.
- All shipwreck coves' spawners have been adjusted to give compatible mobs enchanted iron or diamond armour and weapons while in its ominous state. The armour given to the mobs will also use the automaton trim. We upped the difficulty because it was too easy now that your Pokémon can fight for you.
- One TM of the elemental hyper beams has been added as guaranteed loot to the main treasure chest in every shipwreck cove. (Magma Cove gets Blast Burn, Lush Cove gets Frenzy Plant, and Submerged Cove gets Hydro Cannon.)
- The following items can now be obtained by brushing the following Pokémon:
  - Pink Wool - Wigglytuff
  - White Wool - Swablu, Altaria
  - Shed Shell - Ekans, Arbok, Dratini, Dragonair, Dunsparce, Treecko, Grovyle, Sceptile, Seviper, Scraggy, Scrafty, Helioptile, Heliolisk, Salandit, Salazzle, Sobble, Drizzile, Inteleon, Silicoblra, Sandaconda, Toxel, Toxtricity, Orthworm, Dudunsparce
  - Phantom Membrane - Dreepy, Drakloak, Dragapult
- The following items can now be obtained by evolving the following Pokémon into any of their evolutions:
  - Turtle Scute - Squirtle, Wartortle, Turtwig, Grotle, Tirtouga, Chewtle
  - Shed Shell - Metapod, Kakuna, Ekans, Paras, Venonat, Krabby, Scyther, Kabuto, Dratini, Dragonair, Ledyba, Spinarak, Yanma, Pineco, Dunsparce, GLigar, Pupitar, Treecko, Grovyle, Silcoon, Cascoon, Surskit, Nincada, Trapinch, Vibrava, Corphish, Anorith, Bagon, Shelgon, Kricketot, Burmy, Combee, Skorupi, Swadloon, Whirlipede, Dwebble, Scraggy, Karrablast, Joltik, Larvesta, Spewpa, Clauncher, Helioptile, Charjabug, Crabrawler, Cutiefly, Dewpider, Salandit, Wimpod, Poipole, Sobble, Drizzile, Dottler, Silicobra, Toxel, Sizzlipede, Snom, Tarountula, Nymble, Rellor
- Saccharine Leaves now drop Tart, Sweet, or Syrupy Apples, depending on their honey coating stage, instead of vanilla Apples.
- Fixed the height of the Tumblestone Bud items when held in hand, placed on head, viewed in a GUI, and placed in an Item Frame.
- Refactored all advancements, removing several deemed unnecessary. Due to this cleanup, all previously obtained advancements will be reset besides the root (for picking a starter Pokémon). This sucks, and we're sorry. We had to do this eventually so better now than later.
- Forces between colliding hitboxes now factors in the weight of Pokémon.
- Improved berry tree performance on singleplayer and servers.
- Updated stat increase and decrease particle effects with the addition of alpha boost particles.
- Improved the performance of pasture blocks on singleplayer and servers.
- Changed the bait effects of the following items: (Vanilla) Sweet & Glow Berries, Golden & Enchanted Golden Apples (Cobblemon) Custap, Eggant, Hopo & Micle Berries, Sweet Hearts.
- Wild Pokémon now reliably have at least one offensive move if they can have offensive moves at that level. No more free lunches with Pokémon that can't even hurt you.
- Data Monitor can accept Disks (TMs, Music Disks, Upgrade, Dubious Disk, etc.) to change what's being displayed on the screen.
- The party overlay's experience-gained animation now displays the amount of EXP the Pokémon gained.
- Pressing the inventory key now closes the Pokémon interact wheel GUI.
- Updated the sound for harvesting Apricorns.
- Lowered the volume of harvesting berries.
- Improved compatibility with various mods
    - Farmer's Delight's cutting board can now be used to strip Apricorn and Saccharine's logs, or salvage their planks from various blocks. It can also separate their boats from chests.
    - Farmer's Delight's cutting board can be used to get two white dye from Pep-Up Flowers and two magenta dye from Medicinal Leeks.
    - Farmer's Delight's cutting board can separate Tumblestone Blocks back into Tumblestones.
    - Farmer's Delight's cutting board can salvage Type Gems from their Gem Blocks.
    - Farmer's Delight's Onions, Tomatoes, and Cabbages can be used to cook Open-Faced Sandwiches. Nature's Spirit's Olives also can be used.
    - Farmer's Delight's cutting board can be used on Hearty Grains to obtain rice and straw, similarly to Farmer's Delight's Rice Panicles.
    - Farmer's Delight's Apple Pies and Apple Ciders can now be made using Applin Apples, alongside the Vanilla counterpart.
    - Amendments allows for cooking Leek and Potato Stew in a Cauldron.
    - Any mods that utilise Moonlight's Soft Fluid system can store Leek and Potato Stew, Medicinal Brew, Antidote, Awakening, Burn Heal, Ice Heal, Paralyze Heal, Full Heal, Potion, Super Potion, Hyper Potion, Max Potion, Full Restore, Ability Capsules, Moomoo Milk, and Berry Juice in liquid form (such as Suplementaries' Jar or Goblet, or Cauldrons while using Amendments).
    - Supplementaries' Hourglass can now use Bright Powder, Quick Powder, Metal Powder, Heal Powder, Silver Powder, and Remedy.
    - Berry Trees are now compatible with the Planter properly
    - Saccharine Way Signs (added by Supplementaries automagically) now use a premade texture to prevent odd visual issues.
    - Supplementaries' Jar can now store various Cobblemon cookies, candies, and similar items.
    - Some of Supplementaries' items have been added to the `#cobblemon:held/container_held_items` item tag, including sacks, safes, and lunch baskets.
    - Experience Nuggets can be used in place of Sculk for making the EXP Candies if using Create.
    - Rage Candy Bar has a Create Mixing recipe.
    - All Cobblemon ores can now be crushed in Create's Crushing Wheels. All Gem and Tumblestone Clusters can be crushed for automatic, low return, gems.
    - Hearty Grains can be milled like Farmer's Delight Rice Panicles if both Farmer's Delight and Create are installed.
    - Big Roots and Revival Herbs can be milled to their respective powders.
    - Pep-Up Flowers, Medicinal Leeks, and all 70 berries can be milled in Create's Millstone for additional dye drops.
    - Auspicious Armour and Upgrades can be Haunted using Create's crafting systems.
    - Applin Apples can be used to make Honeyed Apples in Create.
- Sounds for interacting with various Cobblemon blocks now play from the centre of the block, rather than the corner. You probably didn't notice.
- Dragonite's mailbag cosmetic can now also be obtained with a chest in the cosmetic slot.
- Adjusted the walk speed for Croagunk and Aerodactyl.
- The `/pc` command no longer plays PC activation sounds
- Pressing the Summary key while either the starter selection or summary screen are open now closes those screens.
- Ice type Pokémon are now immune to Packed Snow.
- Added cobweb block slowness immunity for spider Pokémon

### Fixes
- Fixed rare Pokémon being far too likely to spawn multiple times in a single spawn cycle. The dev told me that the exact bug is too complicated to explain.
- Fixed Omanyte and Omastar incorrectly using water animations on land.
- Fixed Pokédex layout for genderless variations.
- Fixed odd stacking behaviour with Poké Baits.
- Fixed a compatibility issue with World Game Rules which caused some log spam in specific cases.
- Fixed improper validation of Pokémon when performing a trade.
- Fixed an issue where particles like beams can disappear when you don't see the beginning of the beam, or you look away.
- Fixed Bedrock particle materials sometimes being incorrectly invisible from some sides.
- Fixed an occasional crash on retrieving revived fossils.
- Fixed brushing not working on Neoforge. Again.
- Fixed braking not working for submarine-style mounts (whoops).
- Fixed strafing not having the same friction as forward movement (funny whoops).
- Fixed submarine-style mounts' surface-water animations not playing when supposed to.
- Fixed submarine-style mounts' camera freaking out when looking up or down on the surface.
- Fixed pastured Pokémon despawning and running away.
- Fixed Apricorn trees crashing when other mods bonemeal them.
- Fixed the issue that caused hover-style mounts without a ground style to be rendered useless upon touching the ground on a server.
- Fixed horizontal and vertical collisions with hover-style mounts so they no longer accumulate or retain momentum.
- Fixed NeoForge brewing stand unexpectedly crashing users when shift clicking items within its menu. Well, I suppose all crashes are unexpected. You know what I mean.
- Fixed NPCs switching Pokémon very often during battles.
- Fixed Campfire Pot causing crashes under certain circumstances.
- Fixed Type Gems not being consumed upon use in battles.
- Fixed several Ancient Pokéball's not using the correct capture multiplier.
- Fixed a server warning that could occur when recalling Pokémon.
- Fixed sliding particles incorrectly handling block collision.
- Fixed Full Heal not curing status conditions in battle. Literally it's one job.
- Fixed a rare issue with battles locking up when you are forced to switch, with the switch menu appearing instantly.
- Fixed the combined effects of Pledge moves having broken Showdown message handling and localisation.
- Fixed a very niche issue where structures would spawn in an incorrect location, creating very funky world gen.
- Fixed Galarian Ponyta missing its cry.
- Fixed various log warnings caused by redundant files and sound events.
- Traded Pokémon will now retain the original friendship level when traded back to its OT.
- Tumblestone Clusters now display correctly on maps.
- Fixed removing mulch from berry trees with a shovel not working. That was meant to be a thing.
- Fixed collecting honey from Saccharine Leaf blocks deleting Honey Bottles when the inventory was full.
- Fixed Stripped Saccharine Wood recipe being... not there.
- Fixed some performance issues with a kind of sound event causing lag by attempting to create sounds every tick when out of range of hearing.
- Fixed stat-reducing Aprijuice not being possible to apply on a maxed out Pokémon. Also fixed the possibility of going into negatives.
- Fixed exploit where you could take out the bait or drop your Pokérod with bait to avoid consuming bait, now the bobber will just disappear if you do so.
- Fixed Apricorn and Saccharine boats incorrectly using chest boat models.
- Fixed wild and trainer battle AI refusing to select moves with the `adjacentAlly` target type, even when it's their only option.
- Fixed gilded chests being more accessible than intended.
- Fixed fished up Pokémon not being added as "seen" to the Pokédex.
- Fixed surprised Gimmighoul encounters not being added as "seen" to the Pokédex.
- Fixed a crash involving berry trees that have been world edited.
- Fixed visual desync in multiplayer for players mounting Pokémon outside other players' loaded chunks.
- Fixed Pokémon entities leveled by rare candy not getting stronger as Minecraft entities unless recalled.
- Fixed a freeze during game load that occurred when multiple mods tried to load Cobblemon API classes at the same time.
- Lowered the volume of Blitzle and Zebstrika's cry (shut up!).
- Regional Foods will now prioritise being eaten instead of used for healing Pokémon - shift clicking will use it as healing.
- Resolved z-fighting (texture flickering) on Pokédex Models.
- Restored Ninjask's ability to do barrel rolls.
- Fixed Raichu (male) and Alolan Raichu (both genders) not displaying the correct Partner Cap when Pewter Crunchies are in the cosmetic slot.
- Fixed a crash caused by adding enchanted items to the Resurrection Machine.
- Fixed a crash that could occur when starting a PvN battle with only fainted Pokémon.
- Fixed the Remember Riding Camera config not being respected when dismounting and resolved the incompatibility with the Auto Third Person mod.
- Fixed Full Heal block not dropping Full Heals. Lmao.
- Fixed status cure items not returning an empty bottle when used.
- Fixed Panpour consuming its held item when evolving with a Water Stone.
- Fixed Smoked Tail Curry returning a Wooden Bowl when consumed despite it not being included in the recipe. Free bowls!
- Fixed `/giveallpokemon` not respecting the min and max arguments.
- Fixed the choose starter toast not disappearing when capturing a Pokémon instead of opening the starter selection screen.
- Fixed an issue where certain Sinister Tea seasonings were only applying as instant effects and would not apply over time.
- Long config option labels now scroll instead of overflowing in the configuration menu.
- Fixed some z-fighting and clipping on Dewott and Hisui-Bias Dewott.
- Eggant Berries can now be composted properly on NeoForge.
- Composting chances are now the same on NeoForge as on Fabric.
- Fixed problem where furnaces which had smelted Revival Herbs into Heal Powder in older versions would glitch out on trying to get the experience out of the block.
- Fixed the Battle AI not recognizing Surging Strikes as a multistrike move.
- Fixed Tentacool not using its swim animation when on water surface.
- Fixed Eevee using its left shoulder pose when in battle.
- Fixed Magikarp and Gyarados Jump Pattern resourcepacks replacing shiny textures of addons targeting Magikarp or Gyarados.
- Fixed Combee's pollinated texture overwriting the shiny and female textures.
- Fixed a colour mistake with Dracovish's shiny.
- Fixed Togedemaru's back spikes z-fighting.
- Fixed Sliggoo (+ Hisuian) evolving in the Nether and End where it can't actually rain.
- Corrected the scales, hitbox sizes, and eye heights for Ariados, Cetoddle, Durant, Galvantula, Klink, Lanturn, Lumineon, Mantine, Mantyke, Mudbray, Numel, Staravia, and Torkoal.
- Fixed Torkoal's walk speed not matching its animation. He will no longer move faster than Bunnelby and Buneary. This tortoise would've won.
- Fixed Lanturn T-posing due to missing ground walk and sleep animations. 
- Fixed Oshawott and Dewott using their sleep animation in unintended scenarios. 
- Fixed Dudunsparce and Maushold always having the same form instead of having the 1 in 100 chance of being different.
- Fixed bird mounts rapidly switching between their flying and gliding animations when flying at low speed.
- Fixed some battles being startable with fainted Pokémon in the initial sendout. 
- Fixed random gender selection for forms with strict gender divides (such as Meowstic and Oinkologne) never choosing female (that's sexist).
- Fixed the "Press R to battle" prompt not disappearing after you finish your first battle, at least until you relogged.
- Fixed the composter block being listed as "composer" in the cosmetic items species feature
- Fixed Castform's forms being tagged as introduced in generation 4 instead of 3.
- Fixed Blitzle's base scale being `1` rather than the intended `0.8`.
- Fixed Magnezone's emissive layer for the shiny having the wrong name, thus displaying wrongly.
- Fixed Litleo not blinking.

### Developer
- Added `PokeSnackSpawnerFactory` which allows influence registration on PokeSnack encounters.
- Added `FishingSpawnerFactory` which allows influence registration on fishing encounters.
- Added `BattleFleeAttemptEvent` fired from `PokemonBattle.checkFleeAttempt`, allowing developers to intercept and control flee attempts.
- Tweaked the spawning selector interface to take a bucket function rather than a bucket directly.
- Added a new `cobblemon:height_range` processor type to allow developers to restrict structure-spawning ranges.
- Separated all the functions of MoLangFunctions.kt into their own files.
- Spawn buckets and their base weights are now provided by the spawner, with different base weights for world, fishing, snack, and habitat spawn buckets.
- Removed "SpawnBucket" class in favour of just storing maps of bucket names to weights.
- Fixed nicknames not being applied to Pokémon spawned from `spawn_pool_world` files.
- Added support for `profilePokedexScale`, `profilePokedexTranslation`, `profileSummaryScale`, and `profileSummaryTranslation` in poser files for finer control over profile displays.
- Fixed riding camera offsets defined on Pokémon forms not being applied.
- Marks can now provide aspects.

### Molang & Datapacks
- Added `moveset_builders` datapack folder for different styles of movesets.
- Added `party_pools` datapack folder for defining groups of Pokémon for complex NPC party definitions.
- Added `party_compositions` datapack folder for arranging parties on NPCs that rely on party pools.
- Added `composed_pool` NPC party provider type which combines a party pool with a party composition to create more complex NPC parties.
- Added basic chatter NPC Behaviour.
- Added `q.item.is_enchanted()`.
- Added `q.item.has_enchantment(minecraft:sharpness, 3)`.
- Added `has_chosen_starter` and `get_starter_uuid` as available Molang functions.
- Added `has_tm_move_unlocked`, `unlock_tm_move`, and `lock_tm_move` as available Molang functions for Players.
- Added `marks`, `has_mark`, and `remove_marks` as available Molang functions for Pokémon.
- Added Data Component support for species drops, eg `"components": {"minecraft:custom_model_data": 123}`
- Added the new `sortOrder` field to mark entries, (defaults to 0 if not specified) which controls the order in which marks are rendered on the HUD, with higher numbers being rendered on top of lower numbers.
- Added optional `order` field to starter categories. It will allow explicitly sorting categories in the starter selection screen.
- SpeciesAdditions append vs override now matches the wiki documentation.
- Added `weighted_choice` as a new feature type. It requires setting weights for each choice and allows developers to simplify the process of assigning random aspect choice based on marble chance.
- Added `q.world.spawn_loot_table_items(loot_table_id, x, y, z)` which spawns the items from the loot table at the position. Use type: `minecraft:chest` for the loot table.
- Added `q.pokemon.entity` to access the entity of Pokémon.
- Flamethrower and Seismic Toss had their action effect JSON cleaned up.
- Ride sounds can now be set as exclusive to passengers.
- Ride sounds no longer play when submerged unless specified with a new setting.
- NPC Trainers can now call a `command` animation when issuing a command in battle.
- Added a q.failed function to move action effects.
- Herd spawned Pokémon have their levels controlled differently. The `levelRange` property now acts as a pre-offset clamp instead of a filter, with a new `herdLevelRange` property to do the filter behaviour.
- `q.sound` now accepts three parameters (sound event, volume, and pitch) instead of just the sound event and pitch.
- Added a new layer property that makes a layer scroll in a direction. "scrolling": {"speedU": 0.1, "speedV": 0.1}
- Cleaned up seat data. Removed all now unused fields from seats in all species files. Also made locator seat names explicit in the species files (however, this doesn't break the legacy format)

changelog:
## [1.7.2 (January 25th, 2026)](#1-7-2)

### Additions
- Added Saccharine wood furniture for Adorn.
- Added the Partner Mark, which party Pokémon have a very small chance to earn as the player walks, provided they have enough friendship.
- Added decorative block models for existing items: Potion, Super Potion, Hyper Potion, Max Potion, Full Restore, Antidote, Awakening, Burn Heal, Ice Heal, Paralyze Heal, Full Heal, Ether, Elixir, Max Ether, Max Elixir, X Accuracy, X Attack, X Defence, X Special Attack, X Special Defence, X Speed, Dire Hit, Guard Spec, Weakness Policy, Blunder Policy, Cleanse Tag, and Spell Tag.
- Added decorative sign blocks called Plaques.
- Added ride style labels to ride stats in Pokédex, as well as ride style icons in the summary GUI.
- Added more seasonings for sinister tea:
  - Mental Herb - Mental Restoration I for 10 seconds, which staves off Insomnia.
  - White Herb - Removes negative effects.
  - Milk, Moomoo Milk - Removes effects.
- Added dispenser support for:
  - Applying a Honey Bottle to Saccharine Logs.
  - Washing honey off of Saccharine Slathered Logs.
  - Applying and removing honey on Saccharine Leaves.
- Added riding statistics: `Distance by Pokémon on Land`, `Distance by Pokémon in Air` and `Distance by Pokémon in Liquid`.

### New rideable Pokémon
- Honchkrow 
- Mantine

### Pokémon Added

#### Gen 5
- Throh
- Sawk

#### Gen 6
- Litleo
- Pyroar
- Spritzee
- Aromatisse
- Swirlix
- Slurpuff

### Model updates for the following Pokémon
- Falinks
- Cottonee
- Whimsicott
- Ferroseed
- Ferrothorn
- Chingling
- Chimecho

### Animation updates for the following Pokémon
- Mantine (ride animations)
- Flygon (ride jump animation)
- Honchkrow (ride animations)
- Croagunk
- Toxicroak

### Changes
- Added a new config option, `Enable In-Flight Dismounting` (default: off), which lets you dismount while riding a Pokémon in the air. This is the textbook definition of caveat emptor.
- Ride sounds have been separated into stereo for passengers and mono for other players. Riding will now sound more spacious.
- Battle AI now uses a smarter threshold for switching, reducing unnecessary switches.
- AI will always use the most damaging move when at low HP and when it is not switching, improving endgame decision-making.
- Items given from interacting with Saccharine Leaves are placed in the active hotbar slot if possible.
- Added `label` as an alternate key to the `tag` property.

### Fixes
- Fixed crashing when viewing another player in spectator mode. Some said this was reason to release this update a month ago. They were probably right.
- Fixed crashing when sending a Pokémon out after editing its form.
- Fixed all Pokémon being saved to chunks and never despawning even when they should be.
- Fixed Poké Snacks crashing if there was no available spawn.
- Fixed Poké Snack / Bait effects so that EV Yield, Type, and Egg Group filters now all apply together when weighting spawns. And you thought you were going crazy.
- Fixed Furfrou not being trimmable on NeoForge specifically.
- Fixed honey from Saccharine Leaves being harvestable at less than the max age.
- Fixed possible error on world generation when Combee are placed in naturally generated bee nests.
- Fixed Galarian Weezing crashing the world if it decides to blink the wrong way. The same could happen to you!
- Fixed Galarian Mr. Mime incorrectly being rideable. Some would argue that regular Mr. Mime shouldn't be rideable, but that would make them wrong.
- Fixed missing apricorn textures for Adorn blocks.
- Fixed Apricorn block model rotation for counters/sinks/cupboards/drawers to match that of most recent version of Adorn.
- Fixed item interaction sometimes not working properly when playing on servers.
- Fixed Mint Leaves not being usable for filling the Resurrection Machine.
- Fixed Super Potion recipes incorrectly using Hondew Berry instead of Aguav Berry. They look similar, to be fair.
- Fixed Wishiwashi not schooling properly.
- Fixed battle item duplication issue. How did it work? Wouldn't you like to know, weather boy.
- Fixed the ordering of Aprijuice's riding stat boosts so they always have the same order.
- Fixed the movesets of certain Pokémon being incorrectly sanitized upon reload, causing some forms to keep losing moves.
- Fixed selected leading Pokémon in battle not being used when levels are set.
- Fixed the bottom half of pasture blocks having an incorrect hit-box when facing north or south.
- Fixed gimmicks not being usable in double and triple battles.
- Fixed gimmick buttons showing when already used in the same turn in double and triple battles.
- Fixed mochi items consuming two items at a time.
- Fixed Fresh Start Mochi's EV reset not syncing health changes properly.
- Fixed Pokémon spawn influences not being specific to regional forms.
- Fixed memory leak from battles not being cleaned up after ending.
- Fixed orientation not getting reset after crashing while flying and getting back on the Pokémon.
- Fixed shiny Pokémon not respecting the `silent` flag on spawn.
- Fixed 'Plain' prefix not being applied to all low-quality Aprijuice.
- Fixed Pokémon interactions not playing sound effects when the volume was not specified.
- Fixed Pokémon interaction cooldowns taking longer than intended when the Pokémon was in the player’s party.
- Fixed Pokémon interactions occasionally crashing the game when spamming an interaction with a 0 cooldown.
- Fixed Pokémon fullness decreasing more than intended when the Pokémon was pastured.
- Fixed Scraggy line, Milcery line, and Morpeko spawning on unnatural blocks. 
- Fixed invulnerability-bypassed damage being resisted by invulnerable NPC entities.
- Fixed Fabric network packets not being handled immediately, fixing incompatibilities with Supplementaries, Prometheus, Sleep Tight, and others.
- Fixed killer not being set early enough on a wild Pokémon entity from `WinInstruction`.
- Fixed requirements such as `biomeCondition` crashing the game when used to define Pokémon interactions.
- Fixed an issue that prevented registering custom dispenser behaviours (no longer overrides vanilla behaviour).
- Fixed an issue navigation that prevented Combee from pathing into and out of Saccharine Leaves.
- Added Saccharine Boats and Saccharine Boat with Chests to relevant boat tags.
- Fixed Soothe Bell not being properly tagged as a held item.
- Fixed `/calculateseatpositions` expecting a locator format that even we don't use. It needs an underscore after "seat".
- Fixed the `run_script` Molang function to not fail if the environment's context is null.
- Fixed the Molang functions `date_local_time`, `date_of`, `date_is_after` to use the correct date format.

### Developer
- Changed the `owner` parameter in the `OwnerQueryRequirement` interface from `ServerPlayer` to `Player`. This method is now also called on the client to verify whether a Pokémon interaction succeeded, so make sure to update your implementations to handle both server and client contexts.
- Added the `pnx` to the `BattleFaintedEvent` and `FormeChangeEvent`.
- Added register methods for custom instructions to `ShowdownInterpreter`.
- Changed callback operations in `BattlePokemon` to allow multiple callbacks and be mutable.
- Added `display_name`, `description`, and `max_pp` functions to the `MoveTemplate` struct.
- Changed the implementations of `AIBattleActor` to be open classes to allow extension.
- Changed the resource location of Poké Ball icons in the GUI to use the balls namespace instead of Cobblemon's, allowing mods to properly use their own namespace for these textures.

### Molang & Datapacks
- Ride sounds can now be set as exclusive to passengers.
- Ride sounds no longer play when submerged unless specified with a new setting.
- Exception handling has been added to `run_molang`, resolving some crashes caused by malformed MoLang expressions.
- Added the `create_itemstack`, `has_inventory_space`, `set_inventory_slot`, and `give_item` MoLang functions for item and inventory utility.
- Added the `get_move_from_id` MoLang function for general move info queries without requiring a Moveset object to access.
- Added support for optional message variants in battle activate instructions for more context-specific battle text.
  - Example: `this.add('-activate', pokemon, 'ability: example', '[msg]message1');` will parse to lang key `cobblemon.battle.activate.example.message1`.

### Localization
- Updated translations for:
  - French
  - Canadian French
  - Simplified Chinese
  - Ukrainian
  - Brazilian Portuguese
  - Spanish
  - Korean
  - Japanese
